brief: The canvas displays a retro, text-based terminal console presenting a detective story through simulated command inputs. The text, which advances as the viewer interacts with the display, emits a subtle cyan glow. The primary visual element is the constantly updating text output. As the narrative reveals a significant piece of evidence, the console will glitch dramatically, manifesting as horizontal screen tearing across the entire display. The viewer observes this story unfold, progressing the narrative through discrete interaction.

statement: This sketch creates an interactive retro terminal experience that unfolds a detective story through simulated command inputs. The interface displays text with a subtle cyan glow reminiscent of classic computer terminals, gradually revealing clues as the user interacts with it. When a significant plot point is reached — specifically when the narrative mentions a system glitch — the entire display transforms into a dramatic visual effect featuring horizontal screen tearing across the canvas. The viewer progresses the story by clicking or pressing enter, which advances the text output and triggers the glitch sequence at the appropriate moment. The work combines nostalgic visual elements with an interactive storytelling mechanism that responds to user input to create an engaging narrative experience.
